clause_text: Capital Contributions 3.1 Each Limited Partner shall make Capital Contributions to the Partnership in amounts not to exceed its Unfunded Commitment, upon not less than 10 business days' prior written notice from the General Partner (a "Drawdown Notice").

clause_text: 3.2 The timing and amount of capital calls are at the sole discretion of the General Partner, and a Limited Partner's obligation to fund a capital call is not reduced or deferred because of market conditions.

clause_text: If a Limited Partner fails to fund a capital call when due, the General Partner may charge interest at 10% per annum on the unpaid amount and may cause the Defaulting Limited Partner to forfeit up to 50% of its Capital Account.
